name: Warren
tagline: Scores a ticker against a classic growth checklist, with entry and stop levels
description: The name is an homage, but the method is the CAN SLIM growth checklist. Hand over a ticker and you get a scored verdict, a proper buy setup, one to watch, or one to avoid, plus the entry, stop, and market read it would use, and every judgment lands in a history you can audit. A screening framework, not advice.
author: Ulises__gg
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
